notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
This update contains new Pomodoro App, fixed nightstands center points and some minor fixes.



• New Pomodoro App. Set up your goals and time to complete with the rewards you want to receive!

• Fixed all nightstands issue with them not being centered. Might require to replace them slightly on your current save files

• Minor fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
This update contains several QoL updates and bug fixes.



• Increased maximum task reward from 150 to 999 

• Fixed board game "Wish & Rent" price from 0 to 100 

• Fixed scrolling tasks list 

• Fixed getting Meteorologist achievement after loading your save file

notes.title: Demo QoL Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
A new patch for the demo version has been released, making the gameplay more convenient.

New To-Do tasks now auto-select their placeholder text for quick renaming 

Press Tab to switch between task name and reward fields
